summary: Kimi Antonelli won the Japanese Grand Prix from pole position, 13.7s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Liam Lawson made the biggest climb, from P14 to P9.
Arvid Lindblad had a day to forget, dropping from P10 to P14.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
There were 29 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Kimi Antonelli takes the championship lead, 9 points ahead of George Russell.
